title: Checkout page crashes after payment form submission — 500 Internal Server Error
body:
## Bug Report

**Environment:** Production
**Reported by:** @customer-support (via ticket #CS-9912)

### What happened
Users are getting a 500 Internal Server Error when submitting the payment form on the checkout page. The page crashes after clicking 'Pay Now'. This was working fine until the deploy on 2026-06-25.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Add items to cart
2. Proceed to checkout
3. Fill in payment details (Stripe credit card form)
4. Click 'Pay Now'
5. Page crashes with 500 error

### Expected
Payment processes successfully, user redirected to confirmation page.

### Actual
500 Internal Server Error — no confirmation, payment may or may not have been charged.

### Logs
```
StripeError: No such payment_intent: 'pi_undefined'
  at Object.stripe.paymentIntents.confirm (/app/api/checkout/confirm.js:47)
  at processPayment (/app/api/checkout/confirm.js:23)
```

### Impact
~120 users affected in last 2 hours. Revenue impact estimated at $8,000+.

comments_data.body: Confirmed in prod. All checkout attempts failing since ~14:00 UTC.
Looks like the Stripe payment_intent_id is coming through as undefined. Possibly related to the env var change in the last deploy.
Rolling back deploy v2.4.0 as emergency measure.
